description.main: Willy Vanderperre's first book with IDEA reprints his entire Instagram feed, all 635 square photographs in the order he posted them, three to a page across 220 pages. Published in London in September 2015 in an edition of 300, it was edited, designed and printed in ten days and launched at Dover Street Market New York.
description.extended:
Willy Vanderperre's first book with IDEA reprints his entire Instagram feed, all 635 square photographs in the order he posted them, edited, designed and printed in ten days.

IDEA published it in London in September 2015 in an edition of 300. The softcover runs to 220 pages with three images to a page, so studio portraits, campaign outtakes, landscapes and phone snapshots sit side by side as unplanned triptychs. Nothing was recropped or re-edited, and the low-resolution files were printed as they were. The number in the title is the count of posts when the book went to press. David Owen of IDEA proposed the project while Vanderperre was on holiday. The book launched at Dover Street Market New York on 9 September 2015 and went on sale in the London and New York stores the next day. Instagram announced the end of its square-only format the day after the book went to print.

Vanderperre is a Belgian fashion photographer, a long-time collaborator of Raf Simons and the stylist Olivier Rizzo, with campaigns for Prada, Dior and Jil Sander. IDEA followed 635 with 865 (2019), a second volume of posts, and 1500, a 50-copy clothbound edition reprinting both. The library also holds issues of his /12 fanzine series, published by IDEA in 2017.
description.artist_bio: Willy Vanderperre is a Belgian fashion photographer, a long-standing collaborator of Raf Simons and the stylist Olivier Rizzo, with campaign work for Prada, Dior and Jil Sander and editorial work for magazines including AnOther, i-D and Vogue. His books with IDEA include 635 (2015), 865 and 1500 (both 2019) and the twelve-issue /12 fanzine series (2017).

notes: Shelf: Fashion. Edition of 300, no ISBN. Title as printed on the cover: 635 WILLY VANDERPERRE; the 635 is the number of photographs, the full run of the artist's Instagram posts to date, printed three to a page. Launched at Dover Street Market New York on 9 September 2015, sold at Dover Street Market London and New York from 10 September 2015. Followed by 865 (IDEA, 2019, softcover, 296 pp, with the fanzine 485 Remixed) and 1500 (IDEA, 2019, clothbound hardcover, 504 pp, edition of 50), which reprints 635. IDEA's original product page (idea-books.com/635.html, giving softcover, 20 x 25 cm, 220 pages, edition of 300) survives only in the Wayback Machine; the domain is now parked and the current IDEA shop (ideanow.online) has no 635 page. Cover is the ROCKET/AbeBooks seller photograph cropped to the front board.
